result.summary: The PR is a behavior-preserving readability refactor of inBounds. It extracts index < length into a local constant belowUpperBound and returns index >= 0 && belowUpperBound, which is logically equivalent to the original index >= 0 && index < length. Both operands are primitive number values, so the change in evaluation order (the upper-bound comparison now always evaluates before the lower-bound check) has no observable side effects or exceptions. For nonnegative integer length the function still returns true only for 0 <= index <= length-1, and for empty collections (length 0) it returns false for all indices, preserving the public contract. The acceptance test covers boundary and empty-collection cases and passes. No high-confidence defects found.
